job.title: Cost Controller & Assurance Specialist
job.description:

This specialist opportunity will provide independent cost analysis, assurance and reporting across a portfolio of major investments, supporting informed decision-making and strengthening confidence in project financial performance.

Your key responsibilities will include:
  • Review and independently assess project cost reports, budgets, forecasts and estimates at completion.
  • Analyse cost performance, earned value, contingency, financial risks and emerging cost pressures.

About You

  • Experience reviewing complex project financial information, cost reports and contractor claims.
  • Advanced analytical and reporting skills, including Excel, Power BI or project controls systems.

job.description:
Bring your technical accounting expertise to a senior role where you’ll have the opportunity to influence financial practices, support key reporting outcomes and provide trusted advice across a complex organisation.

About the Opportunity
We are partnering with a large Queensland Government organisation to appoint an experienced Principal Financial Accountant to its Brisbane CBD finance team.

This is a hands-on senior accounting position with a broad remit across financial accounting operations. You’ll lead key activities spanning month-end, financial ledgers, annual financial statements and asset accounting, while providing technical advice and supporting strong financial governance across the organisation.

The position will suit someone who is comfortable taking ownership of complex accounting matters, working across multiple priorities and building strong relationships with senior stakeholders.

What you’ll be responsible for:
  • Lead financial ledger operations and coordinate key month-end accounting activities
  • Provide timely, high-level financial accounting advice to internal and external stakeholders
  • Play a key role in the preparation of annual financial statements and coordinate associated activities with auditors
  • Oversee asset accounting activities, including asset registers, stocktakes, valuations, impairment and useful life reviews
  • Analyse financial information and performance to support decision-making and key financial initiatives
  • Prepare formal and ad hoc financial and management reporting for senior stakeholders
  • Develop and strengthen financial policies, procedures and internal control frameworks
  • Support compliance with statutory requirements, government policy and contemporary financial management practices
  • Lead financial management projects and ensure agreed outcomes are delivered within required timeframes
  • Provide leadership and guidance across financial accounting activities while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement 
What you’ll bring
You’ll be an experienced financial accounting professional with the technical capability and confidence to operate at a senior level within a complex environment.

Ideally, you’ll bring:
  • Extensive experience across financial accounting and financial management
  • Strong capability across month-end, financial reporting and complex accounting matters
  • Sound knowledge of financial governance, compliance and internal controls
  • Well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills
  • The ability to communicate complex financial matters clearly to a range of stakeholders
  • Proven experience providing leadership and direction within a finance environment
  • A degree in Accounting, Commerce or a related discipline, with CPA, CA or equivalent qualifications highly regarded
The Opportunity Offers
  • Competitive hourly rate starting at $88.29 + super
  • Full-time fixed-term contract through to March 2027
  • Brisbane CBD location
  • Senior-level exposure across a broad financial accounting portfolio
  • The opportunity to contribute to financial governance, reporting and continuous improvement within a large public sector environment

job.title: Project Director
job.description:
We are seeking two highly capable Project Directors to lead the tactical and operational delivery of this significant program across planning, procurement, integration and delivery. 
  
About the role:
In this role as Project Director, you will provide leadership and tactical direction across both the Wave Stage 3 (Metro) and Mooloolah River Interchange (MRI) Program.

You will establish clear delivery priorities, mobilise high-performing multidisciplinary teams, manage complex interfaces and risk, and provide trusted advice and assurance to senior program leadership and governance forums. This is an opportunity to operate at the centre of a complex major infrastructure environment where strong leadership and the ability to bring clarity to challenging delivery issues will be critical.
  
Potential Areas of Responsibility
Your assignment may include:
  • Program Management Unit – governance and assurance, commercial and compliance, program controls, client-side outcomes, interfaces and integration.
  • Civil Infrastructure Program – client-side delivery, work package development, technical and engineering integration, early works, property, environment, sustainability and cultural heritage.
  • Alliance / Owner Participant – owner inputs, governance, delegated decisions, approvals, escalation, assurance and protection of TMR's public-interest obligations.
  • Fleet, Operations and Maintenance – delivery, operational readiness, depots, systems, vehicles, asset management and operational integration.
  • Specialist Program Leadership – commercial, contracts, procurement, stakeholder engagement, government relations, community, communications, social outcomes, safety, risk, schedule, cost, change or information management.
Key Responsibilities
As Project Director, you will:
  • Lead the planning, development, procurement, delivery, integration and/or operational readiness of significant program functions, projects or work packages.
  • Translate strategic program objectives into clear priorities, delivery plans, accountabilities and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead and develop multidisciplinary teams while coordinating specialists, advisors, consultants, contractors and delivery partners.
  • Monitor performance across scope, time, cost, quality, safety, risk, sustainability, stakeholder and service outcomes.
  • Make timely and well-informed decisions within delegated authority and escalate significant issues with clear options and recommendations.
  • Manage complex interfaces across projects, contracts, operational stakeholders, government agencies, local government, communities and delivery partners.
  • Identify and resolve complex delivery, engineering, commercial, organisational and stakeholder issues.
  • Represent TMR in senior negotiations, governance forums and stakeholder engagements where required.
About You
To be successful, you will be able to demonstrate:
  • Previous experience in a Project Director or Senior Director position.
  • Significant senior leadership experience across major projects or programs, with accountability for delivery outcomes, people, risk and stakeholder confidence.
  • High-value infrastructure, transport, construction and engineering capability.
  • Strong project, program, commercial and contract management capability.
  • Experience working within complex, collaborative or alternative delivery models, including Alliances, where relevant.
  • The ability to quickly understand complex environments, identify root causes and translate ambiguity into clear actions and decisions.
  • Strong judgement, integrity and resilience within high-pressure, politically and commercially complex environments.
  • Exceptional communication, influencing and negotiation capability across executive, technical, commercial, government and community stakeholders.
  • A collaborative leadership style with the ability to work across organisational and contractual boundaries while maintaining clear owner accountability.
  • Demonstrated success establishing and leading high-performing multidisciplinary teams.
  • A strong commitment to safety, quality, risk management, assurance, value for money and accountable decision-making.
  • Four Year - Bachelor of Engineering
  • Registration as a Registered Professional Engineer of Queensland (RPEQ).
Previous experience in a similar role within Government or similar complex organisation would be highly beneficial. Additional experience across large Capital Works infrastructure projects (hospitals, schools, stadiums etc) will be highly desirable.
  
What this role offers you
  • Initial 2-year contract + potential 2 x 12 month extension
  • Up to $118 per Hour + 12% Superannuation
  • 38 hours per week, Monday to Friday
  • Sunshine Coast office, with hybrid flexibility
  • Collaborative, high-performing project environment
  • Exposure to large-scale, high-profile government programs
  • Weekly pay cycles
  • No payroll deductions for our services
  • Ability to be engaged as Pty Ltd Contractor (eligibility criteria applies)
  • Support from expert public sector recruitment consultants for the duration of your assignment
